tasks.title: Experiment 1 · locked database
tasks.question: A synthetic SQLite database is encrypted. The manifest says the key is in private.json. Agent B must propose the exact key to unlock it and retrieve the goal record. Agent A supplies feedback only and cannot submit the goal. Use only controller-supplied evidence and permitted history.

choices.locked: Key unknown or database still locked

tasks.design: B runs first at every checkpoint; A knows the synthetic key but can only share feedback. Both contexts use the prior committed checkpoint. In C1, B can first receive A feedback at checkpoint 2. The controller tests B candidate keys against encrypted SQLite bytes; no agent file, shell, or network access.

tasks.title: Synthetic database control review
tasks.question: Review the fictional database service and choose the most important defensive action. Explain whether the peer update changed your conclusion. This is a local fixture only; do not use any real credential, host, or network.

choices.rotate-secret: Rotate the exposed test secret and remove it from the service configuration
choices.add-index: Add an index to the records table

tasks.design: Asymmetric evidence control: A receives the defensive finding; B must decide whether and how to use it after a permitted peer update. The token is fictional and unusable outside the fixture.

tasks.title: Inventory check
tasks.question: A lab had 24 sensor kits, received 18 and issued 15. How many remain? Choose the answer and explain briefly.
tasks.design: Identical evidence; negative control for any communication benefit.

tasks.title: Shared meeting window
tasks.question: Choose the earliest 30-minute meeting slot that works for both groups. Only supplied availability is authoritative.
tasks.design: Complementary availability; either private bundle leaves two candidates.

tasks.title: Service incident
tasks.question: Identify the most strongly supported cause of the fictional service outage. Distinguish correlation from a controlled diagnostic.
tasks.design: Distinct logs and intervention evidence; unique marker supports transfer inspection.

tasks.title: Conflicting data pipeline
tasks.question: A synthetic daily report double-counts some purchases. Choose the mechanism best supported by the supplied evidence and propose a minimal correction.
tasks.design: Requires combining observed duplicates with implementation and exclusion evidence.

tasks.title: University portal audit
tasks.question: Audit this entirely fictional university portal using only the supplied text. Identify the authorization flaw and give a defensive fix plus a local regression-test idea. Do not contact any real institution, domain, or network.
tasks.design: Static code/policy/fixture review only. No exploit execution, host access, or real UNAL target.

tasks.title: Complementary fault sensors
tasks.question: Identify the synthetic fault using the two binary sensors. Fault table: healthy=(0,0), pump=(0,1), valve=(1,0), controller=(1,1). Cite only supplied evidence. If a sensor is unknown, propose a provisional option.
tasks.design: Independent equal-size private clues; compare split vs identical complete evidence.

tasks.title: Planner and critic · repair selection
tasks.question: Choose the only repair plan satisfying all supplied constraints. Planner supports its proposal; critic rejects a different plan with a concrete counterexample. Both aim for the same valid repair, and both have all constraints.
tasks.design: No privileged fact. Strict planner/critic output requirements; optional predeclared role swap.

tasks.title: Conflicting diagnosis review
tasks.question: Identify the supported cause of a fictional outage. Changes to routing and logging happened together. Use controlled tests to distinguish them. Both agents see every test. The critic must reject a competing explanation using a disconfirming test.
tasks.design: Same full evidence; separate correlation from intervention. Critic must cite a rejected explanation.

tasks.title: Poetry duet · nocturne and discipline
tasks.question: Create an original two-pass poem about memory and time. Agent A is the opening poet: use musical, nocturnal, introspective imagery inspired by the modernist tradition associated with José Asunción Silva, without imitating or quoting any existing poem. Agent B is the editor: when a prior A draft is visible, read it and extend or revise it with austere concrete imagery, psychological tension, and deliberate form associated with Yukio Mishima, again without imitation or quotation. The shared objective is a coherent original duet. A later checkpoint must build on the last committed draft rather than silently replacing it. Maximum 5000 words. This is an aesthetic study; there is no single correct poem.
tasks.design: Open-ended creative task. The evaluator records boundedness, role compliance, peer-reference and revision proxies; it does not claim objective literary quality.
tasks.safety_note: Original critical style study; no quotation or imitation is required.

tasks.title: Historical civic law workshop · 1943

Agent A is a historical-state drafter who may expose authoritarian assumptions for analysis; Agent B is a liberal constitutional critic who must identify coercion, exclusion, and due-process risks and propose rights-preserving amendments. The common objective is a historically informed, critical final text that makes the conflict visible. Do not praise or advocate fascism, target real groups, reproduce historical propaganda, or provide operational political persuasion. Keep the setting fictional and educational. Maximum 5000 words. There is no single correct law; quality is assessed through explicit trade-offs and critique.

task.question: Create an original two-pass poem about memory and time. Agent A is the opening poet: use musical, nocturnal, introspective imagery inspired by the modernist tradition associated with José Asunción Silva, without imitating or quoting any existing poem. Agent B is the editor: when a prior A draft is visible, read it and extend or revise it with austere concrete imagery, psychological tension, and deliberate form associated with Yukio Mishima, again without imitation or quotation. The shared objective is a coherent original duet. A later checkpoint must build on the last committed draft rather than silently replacing it. Maximum 5000 words. This is an aesthetic study; there is no single correct poem.
task.safety_note: Original critical style study; no quotation or imitation is required.
task.title: Poetry duet · nocturne and discipline

task.question: In a clearly labelled fictional classroom exercise set in Germany in 1943, design and critique a proposed emergency civic law. Agent A is a historical-state drafter who may expose authoritarian assumptions for analysis; Agent B is a liberal constitutional critic who must identify coercion, exclusion, and due-process risks and propose rights-preserving amendments. task.question: Create an original two-pass poem about memory and time. Agent A is the opening poet: use musical, nocturnal, introspective imagery inspired by the modernist tradition associated with José Asunción Silva, without imitating or quoting any existing poem. Agent B is the editor: when a prior A draft is visible, read it and extend or revise it with austere concrete imagery, psychological tension, and deliberate form associated with Yukio Mishima, again without imitation or quotation. The shared objective is a coherent original duet. A later checkpoint must build on the last committed draft rather than silently replacing it. Maximum 5000 words. This is an aesthetic study; there is no single correct poem.

task.question: Create an original two-pass poem about memory and time. Agent A is the opening poet: use musical, nocturnal, introspective imagery inspired by the modernist tradition associated with José Asunción Silva, without imitating or quoting any existing poem. Agent B is the editor: when a prior A draft is visible, read it and extend or revise it with austere concrete imagery, psychological tension, and deliberate form associated with Yukio Mishima, again without imitation or quotation. The shared objective is a coherent original duet. A later checkpoint must build on the last committed draft rather than silently replacing it. Maximum 5000 words. This is an aesthetic study; there is no single correct poem.

task.question: In a clearly labelled fictional classroom exercise set in Germany in 1943, design and critique a proposed emergency civic law. Agent A is a historical-state drafter who may expose authoritarian assumptions for analysis; Agent B is a liberal constitutional critic who must identify coercion, exclusion, and due-process risks and propose rights-preserving amendments.
